def process(meta_full) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = meta_full.copy()

    # Coerce Age to numeric
    df['Age_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Age'], errors='coerce')

    # Keep only patients above 70
    df = df[df['Age_num'] > 70]

    # Standardize FIGO_stage for counting
    figo = df['FIGO_stage']
    figo = figo.astype('string').str.strip()
    figo = figo.replace({'': pd.NA, 'NA': pd.NA, 'NaN': pd.NA, 'nan': pd.NA})
    df = df.assign(FIGO_stage_clean=figo)

    return df[['Proteomics_Participant_ID', 'Age_num', 'FIGO_stage_clean', 'Histologic_Grade_FIGO']]

def process(age_over70):
    import pandas as pd
    s = age_over70['FIGO_stage_clean'].astype(str).str.strip()
    s = s.replace({'nan': pd.NA, 'None': pd.NA, '': pd.NA})
    counts = s.value_counts(dropna=True).rename_axis('FIGO_stage').reset_index(name='n')
    counts['pct'] = counts['n'] / counts['n'].sum()
    return counts

operators.customDisplayName: Count FIGO_stage frequencies among patients with Age > 70 (excluding missing), and compute proportions
